description.narrative: Mediterranean Women's Fund (MedWF) is a philanthropic organization that aims to improve the situation of women and girls in countries around the Mediterranean by supporting women's rights organizations and strengthening feminist movements. In addition to providing financial support for women's organizations, MedWF also includes association consolidation and networking. They aim to strengthen the Mediterranean women's movement in a holistic way by funding in ways that meet feminist principles, training young activists, creating spaces for associations to meet, and leading on collective advocacy actions at national and international levels.
